article_manifest.title: The Sahel’s Dangerous Calm: What Does the Lull in Jihadist Fighting Really Hide?
article_manifest.original_title: The Sahel’s Dangerous Calm: What Does the Lull in Jihadist Fighting Really Hide?
article_manifest.summary: The reported easing of fighting between jihadist rivals in the Mali-Burkina Faso-Niger tri-border region may look like relief for governments struggling to contain an expanding insurgency. It should not be read that way. After months of fierce confrontations between Jama’at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin (JNIM) and Islamic State Sahel Province (ISSP), clashes between the two have reportedly slowed since late October.

article_manifest.title: Over 76,000 Burkinabés repatriated from Guinea following measures against illegal gold mining
article_manifest.original_title: Plus de 76.000 Burkinabè rapatriés de Guinée après des mesures contre l’orpaillage illégal
article_manifest.summary: Since the beginning of November, Guinea has intensified operations against illegal gold panning, particularly in the gold-rich Siguiri region (north-east). The government accuses this activity of causing significant environmental damage and claims to want to put an end to the unregulated exploitation of mineral resources. .

article_manifest.title: GOONGA TAN: Mali: After Kidal, a lull...
article_manifest.original_title: GOONGA TAN : Mali : après Kidal, l'accalmie...
article_manifest.summary: GOONGA TAN: Mali: After Kidal, a lull? The press release from the Armed Forces' Directorate of Information and Public Relations (DIRPA), published on 23 October 2026, deserves more than a mere cursory reading. Behind the figures announced lies a military sequence that could mark a turning point in the conduct of the war against armed terrorist groups.

article_manifest.title: Mali: Russia deploys Lancet kamikaze drones against rebels
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : la Russie déploie des drones kamikazes Lancet contre les rebelles
article_manifest.summary: The Russian Africa Corps has carried out at least ten strikes with ZALA Lancet kamikaze drones in Mali since April, according to an analysis by the US research centre Conflict Insights Group (CIG) released on 19 November 2024. Each attack identified involved the Lancet alongside a surveillance drone from the same manufacturer. As such, CIG presents this equipment as a new addition this year.

article_manifest.title: Koulikoro: Curfew extended until 20 December
article_manifest.original_title: Koulikoro : le couvre-feu prolongé jusqu’au 20 décembre
article_manifest.summary: The Governor of the Koulikoro region has renewed the curfew for one month, from 21 November to 20 December 2026. The curfew still applies to the entire region, from midnight to 5 a.m. During these hours, movement is prohibited.

article_manifest.title: ARMY GENERAL STAFF: The DOSAM project alongside the Defence and Security Forces
article_manifest.original_title: ÉTAT-MAJOR DE L’ARMÉE DE TERRE : le projet DOSAM aux côtés des Forces de Défense et de Sécurité
article_manifest.summary: The General Staff of the Army, in collaboration with the Association of Former Pupils of the Prytanée Militaire de Kati, through its DOSAM (Blood and Medicine Donation) project, organised a blood donation day on Friday, 20 November 2026, at its premises. The event was chaired by Colonel Doctor Marius SANOU, Chief Medical Officer of the Army Garrison Medical Centre, in the presence of several military authorities.

article_manifest.title: Côte d'Ivoire-Burkina Faso: Camille Makosso, the "general" who is challenging Ibrahim Traoré
article_manifest.original_title: Côte d’Ivoire-Burkina Faso : Camille Makosso, le « général » qui défie Ibrahim Traoré
article_manifest.summary: Côte d'Ivoire-Burkina Faso: Camille Makosso, the "general" who is defying Ibrahim Traoré Targeted by the Burkinabé justice system, the Ivorian pastor-influencer asserts his loyalty to President Alassane Ouattara. From Conakry to Cotonou, this former gang leader, who has been imprisoned twice, is building political influence through a combination of preaching and spectacle.

article_manifest.title: Mali: The inside story of the “release” of soldiers held captive by the separatist FLA group
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: les dessous de la «libération» de soldats prisonniers du groupe indépendantiste FLA
article_manifest.summary: Mali: The story behind the "release" of soldiers held captive by the separatist FLA group In Mali, on 18 November, the army claimed the release of 24 soldiers held near In-Tebezas, in the Kidal region. . According to the General Staff's statement, it was an operation carried out jointly with its “partners” – the Russian Africa Corps is not named – which made it possible to “neutralise” the “elements” of the “terrorist groups” and to free these soldiers.

article_manifest.title: Niger: What we know about the fuel convoy escorted by Algeria
article_manifest.original_title: Niger: Ce que l'on sait du convoi de carburant escorté par l'Algérie
article_manifest.summary: A few days after the vote on 25 October 2026 in the Algerian Parliament authorising the dispatch of military units to Niger to 'secure energy interests', a first fuel convoy, accompanied by a military escort, entered Niger, heading for Agadez, in the north of the country. During the few days of confirmed Algerian military presence on the ground, a lot of fake news spread on social media.

article_manifest.summary: Burkinabé soldiers in Ouagadougou, 8 October 2022. On Friday, the think tank International Crisis Group (ICG) recommended that the Sahel countries engage in dialogue with the jihadists of JNIM, stating in a report that a military victory appears "out of reach", after more than a decade of conflict. .

article_manifest.title: Burkina Faso: The celebration of 11 December 2026 announced to “reaffirm national sovereignty”
article_manifest.original_title: Burkina: la célébration du 11-Décembre 2026 annoncée pour «réaffirmer la souveraineté nationale»
article_manifest.summary: The Burkinabé government has announced the celebration of 11 December 2026 to "reaffirm national sovereignty", among other things, according to the report of the Council of Ministers on Thursday, 19 November. . It was Burkina Faso's Minister of Justice, Mr Edasso Rodrigue Bayala, who was acting as Minister of State, Minister of Territorial Administration and Mobility, who addressed the Council on the celebration of 11 December 2026, under the theme 'Popular progressive revolution in Burkina Faso: a recognition of resistance to colonial domination and imperialism'.

article_manifest.title: Burkina Faso: A major military parade announced in Ouagadougou for 11 December 2026
article_manifest.original_title: Burkina Faso : Une grande parade militaire annoncée à Ouagadougou pour le 11-Décembre 2026
article_manifest.summary: At its meeting on Thursday, 19 November 2026, the Council of Ministers considered a communication concerning the celebration of 11 December 2026. This year's event will be held under the theme 'The People's Progressive Revolution in Burkina Faso: a celebration of resistance to colonial domination and imperialism'. According to the minutes of the Council of Ministers, this celebration aims to reaffirm national sovereignty and to demonstrate, before the people of Burkina Faso and the international community, full control over the nation's destiny.

article_manifest.title: Dosso: The Minister of Agriculture and Livestock at the irrigated sites of Dallol
article_manifest.original_title: Dosso : Le Ministre de l’Agriculture et de l’Élevage sur les sites irrigués du Dallol
article_manifest.summary: Dosso, 20 November (ANP) – On Thursday, 19 November, the Minister of Agriculture and Livestock, Colonel Bilaly Gambo, accompanied by the Governor of the Dosso Region, the Director General of the National Office for Hydro-Agricultural Development (ONAHA), senior officials from the Ministry, Regional Directors, and officials from the Defence and Security Forces, carried out a field visit to several developed irrigated sites.

article_manifest.title: Burkina Faso/Security: Minister Mahamadou Sana focuses on pooling resources and coordinating action to enhance effectiveness (…)
article_manifest.original_title: Burkina/Sécurité : Le ministre Mahamadou Sana mise sur la mutualisation des moyens et la synergie d’action pour renforcer l’efficacité (…)
article_manifest.summary: Burkina Faso/Security: Minister Mahamadou Sana focuses on pooling resources and coordinating action to enhance the effectiveness of the forces. The Minister of Security, Mahamadou Sana, chaired the proceedings of the 2nd Ministerial Sector Board (CASEM) for Security on Friday, 20 November 2026, in Ouagadougou. This meeting is being held on the theme "Pooling of resources and synergy of action between the security forces: a strategic imperative for an integrated and effective response to security challenges".
